475:   const risk = direction === "upside" ? entry - stop : stop - entry;
476:   const reward = direction === "upside" ? target - entry : entry - target;
477: 
478:   if (risk <= 0 || reward <= 0) return null;
479: 
480:   return reward / risk;
481: }
